## ⚡ About Me

- **Location:** Based in **Ludhiana, Punjab, India** — open to global remote and on-site software engineering opportunities.
- **Experience:** **Software Engineer Intern @ Talmee** *(Manchester, UK · Remote, Feb 2026 – Aug 2026)* — built production web and mobile features across **React, Next.js, React Native, and Node.js**.
- **What I Build:** End-to-end full-stack web and mobile products featuring **real-time communication (WebSockets), geolocation & maps, robust authentication, open-source tools, and practical LLM/AI integrations**.
- **Education:** Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA).
- **Current Focus:** Scalable system design, offline-first mobile workflows, and agentic AI architectures.
